page.overview:
Who is Zamîn?

Zamîn was an old woman of Númenór who served Erendis, the wife of Tar-Aldarion.

She lived in the countryside of Emerië in an isolated house that belonged to Erendis. She befriended Ancalimë in her childhood.

Based on the phonetic flavor of the name,Zamîn appears to be Adûnaic.
